# PushPad — Task Outline & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 02 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-02/`)
- **New Name**: `pushpad` (`@free-react-templates/pushpad`)
- **Deploy Target**: `pushpad.free.componentdock.com`

## Section Structure

1. **Navbar**: Brand logo "PushPad", nav links, dark mode toggle.
2. **Hero Section**: Introduction to advanced button styles and components.
3. **Button Showcase**:
   - Standard & Rounded Buttons
   - Icon Buttons (Like, Delete, Send, Download)
   - Dropdown Buttons
   - Group Buttons & Outline Buttons
   - Checkboxes & Radio Buttons (Primary, Success, Danger, Warning, Disabled)
   - Slide Toggles / Switches
   - Social Buttons (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Dribbble)
4. **Footer**: Copyright + mandatory link to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Design Notes

- Clean Bootstrap 5 inspired aesthetic with modern Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes.
- Fully interactive components with hover and active states.
